opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 for Scheme (A), up to £500 for Scheme (B), up to £300 for Scheme (C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligible applicants include undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral scientist members of The Society within six years of their PhD viva. Supervisors must be current members of the Genetics Society.
opportunities.summary: The purpose of these grants is to support the attendance of Genetics Society 'junior scientist' members at conferences on research in Genetics.

opportunities.title: Summer Studentship

amount.raw: £425/week allowance for up to 8 weeks, up to £750 to cover host laboratory expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to undergraduate students, except those in their first or final year. Both the student and the research group leader must be members of the Genetics Society.
opportunities.summary: Grants available to support undergraduate students to gain experience in any area of genetics by doing a research project during the summer holiday prior to the final year of their degree.
